text: Deploy by connecting a Git repo; Railway detects your code and configures build settings automatically
quote: Connect your repo, Railway handles the rest. Auto-config, instant previews, no new tools to learn.

text: Visualize the whole stack on a canvas and edit settings directly there, with YAML optional
quote: Modify settings directly from the canvas. YAML optional.

text: Private networking, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing are live as soon as you deploy
quote: Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.

text: HTTP, TCP, gRPC, and WebSocket traffic are handled automatically
quote: HTTP, TCP, gRPC, WebSockets handled automatically.

text: Scale CPU and RAM vertically, or add load-balanced replicas
quote: Scale CPU and RAM or add replicas with load balancing.

text: Run applications in regions closer to your users
quote: Run your application closer to where your users are.

text: Build custom dashboards with metrics from any service
quote: Create custom dashboards with metrics from any service.

text: Alerts go to Slack, Discord, or email when conditions you specify are met
quote: Slack, Discord, or emails the moment conditions you specify are met.

text: All logs are viewable in one place
quote: All logs in one place. Spot issues without switching tools.

text: Unlimited environments so the whole team can ship at the same time
quote: Unlimited environments mean everyone can ship simultaneously.

text: Every pull request gets its own preview deployment
quote: Every pull request gets its own preview. No surprises after merge.

text: Instantly roll back to any previous version
quote: Rollback to any previous version instantly when something breaks.

text: Set hard spending limits on cloud costs
quote: really gotta commend @Railway for allowing hard spending limits, I have never, ever seen this with any cloud provider.

text: Develop locally and deploy from the terminal using the Railway CLI
quote: Develop locally and deploy from your terminal with the Railway CLI.

text: Official MCP server and Agent Skills for AI-powered workflows
quote: Build with Railway using Agent Skills and the MCP server for AI-powered workflows.

text: AI assistants can create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables, and redeploy services
quote: It lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables, and redeploy services.

text: One-click deployable templates and starters for common use cases
quote: One-click deployable applications and starters for common use cases.

text: A single command installs the CLI, agent skills, and MCP config, and checks authentication
quote: This installs or reuses the Railway CLI, installs the `use-railway` skill, configures Railway MCP for detected tools, and checks Railway authentication.

text: The use-railway skill teaches AI coding agents how to operate Railway
quote: The use-railway skill teaches AI coding agents how to operate Railway.

text: Connect via CLI or OAuth from Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex, Copilot, Windsurf, and other tools
quote: Connect through the CLI or OAuth. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex, Copilot, Droid, OpenCode, Windsurf, and more.

text: Cloud agent machines keep files on a persistent disk and keep running after you disconnect
quote: Railway prepares the environment and carries available coding-agent credentials from your machine. Your files stay on the agent's disk, and the machine stays running when you disconnect.

text: Use Claude Desktop to drive Claude Code running on a remote Railway cloud agent
quote: Use Claude Desktop to work on a Railway cloud agent. Claude Code runs on the remote machine, with its development tools and persistent disk, while you prompt it and review changes in Desktop.

text: Codex Desktop connects over SSH to work on files and run commands on a Railway cloud agent
quote: Give Codex Desktop a project on a Railway computer. The app connects over SSH, and Codex reads files, runs commands, and makes changes on your cloud agent.

text: Local coding-agent credentials can be copied to cloud agents, and existing credentials are preserved on reuse
quote: Railway can copy your local `~/.codex/auth.json` to the agent over SSH.

text: The CLI starts an authenticated OpenCode server on a cloud agent and gives your client the connection details
quote: The CLI starts an authenticated OpenCode server on a cloud agent, checks its HTTPS connection, and gives your client everything it needs to connect.

text: Run several sessions on one cloud agent machine and return to the same files later
quote: You can run several sessions on one machine, connect through a desktop app, and return to the same files later.

text: Railway CA lets you browse machines, start sessions, and resume work that is still running
quote: Railway CA gives you one place to browse your machines, start sessions, and return to work that's still running.

text: Sleeping a cloud agent stops compute billing while keeping its files
quote: Sleeping stops its processes and compute billing while retaining files; deleting the agent removes its disk.

text: Built-in chat AI agent in the dashboard can create and configure services, inspect deployments, and diagnose failures
quote: The Railway Agent is a chat-based AI assistant built into the Railway dashboard. It can operate the platform on your behalf: creating and configuring services, inspecting deployments, diagnosing failures, and opening pull requests to fix br

text: The agent finds the cause of a failed deployment and opens a pull request with a proposed fix
quote: Identify the cause of a failed deployment and open a pull request against your repository with a proposed fix.

text: The agent can create services, set variables, connect databases, wire networking, and adjust resource limits
quote: Create services, set variables, connect databases, wire up networking, and adjust resource limits.

text: The agent automatically investigates when a deployment fails
quote: When a deployment fails, the agent can automatically investigate.

text: Connect Notion, Linear, Sentry, or any remote MCP server so the agent can read from them
quote: Connect Notion, Linear, or Sentry from the catalog, or point Railway at any remote MCP server you run, and the agent can read from it while it works on your projects.

text: Mention @Railway in Slack or Discord to inspect deployments, read logs, and make changes
quote: Once installed, mention **@Railway** in Slack or Discord to ask about your projects, inspect deployments, read logs, and make changes

text: Bring your own models by signing in with ChatGPT or OpenRouter to run the agent
quote: [Bring Your Own Models](/ai/bring-your-own-models) lets you sign in with ChatGPT or OpenRouter and run the agent on that account instead of a Railway model.

text: Guided migration path from Heroku
quote: Migrate from Heroku
